reason: My first thought is that my relative could do this for free, but I am nervous about TDS and T1135 and I do not want him getting it wrong on my behalf. A CA on the call before anything moves and no fee until the money lands takes most of the risk off me, so I would try it once with my NRO money.
objection: I cannot verify the CA or the partner bank from a page like this, and I still do not know if the CA will tell me what to report in Canada or only handle the Indian side. If something goes wrong with the tax filing, I am the one who answers for it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the CA's name and credentials plus the bank name up front, a confirmed FINTRAC registration I can look up myself, and a clear statement of what the CA covers on the Canadian reporting side.
